scenes.narration: Microduck learned to walk in a simulation before it ever took a real step.
scenes.on_screen_text: Learned to walk before step one
scenes.image_prompt: Photo-real medium shot of Arjun, an Indian man about 35, calm and curious expression, speaking to camera in a tidy studio with a small desktop robot on the table, soft key light, eye-level camera
scenes.speaker: Arjun

scenes.narration: Hugging Face's Microduck is a 25-centimetre walking robot, under 800 grams. Its CEO says it's heading for about 20,000 preorders.
scenes.image_prompt: Photo-real close-up of a small bipedal robot standing on a workbench next to a ruler, shallow depth of field, warm workshop light
scenes.speaker: Meera

scenes.narration: Fifteen motors, a camera, a depth sensor, and a beak that lifts about 100 grams. It walks, crouches, and gets up after falls.
scenes.image_prompt: Photo-real macro shot of small robot servo motors and wiring inside a compact robot body, electronics workbench, neutral light
scenes.speaker: Arjun

scenes.narration: So how? Reinforcement learning in a physics simulator. Fall, retry, improve.
scenes.image_prompt: Photo-real over-the-shoulder shot of a computer monitor showing an illustrative physics simulation of a robot falling and standing up, dim office
scenes.speaker: Meera

scenes.narration: Then the skill transfers to the real robot. That's sim-to-real.
scenes.image_prompt: Photo-real low-angle shot of a small robot taking steps across a smooth indoor floor, soft daylight from a window
scenes.speaker: Arjun

scenes.narration: At Nvidia GTC Berlin, four live demo robots stumbled and wandered. Real floors are hard.
scenes.image_prompt: Photo-real wide shot of a technology conference stage with small robots on a demo floor and an audience watching, bright stage lighting
scenes.speaker: Meera

scenes.narration: The software is open source. The hardware designs aren't, according to Pollen.
scenes.image_prompt: Photo-real over-the-shoulder shot of a developer's laptop showing lines of code, desk with robot parts nearby, evening light
scenes.speaker: Arjun

scenes.narration: $399 before tax and shipping. New orders take about four to six months. A dev platform, not a toy.
scenes.image_prompt: Photo-real close-up of a hand holding a credit card beside a laptop showing a generic online checkout page, cozy desk
scenes.speaker: Meera

scenes.narration: A robot that practises in a simulation, then wakes up already walking. Follow for more robots learning to walk.
scenes.image_prompt: Photo-real front-facing shot of a small bipedal robot walking toward the camera on a wooden floor, soft warm light
scenes.speaker: Arjun
